name: ClassroomObservationForm
tagline: Lesson observations and learning walks with time-stamped evidence, framework ratings and teacher acknowledgement.
description: A Power Platform code component that turns one Dataverse column into a complete classroom observation workflow: a lesson timer and time-stamped evidence notes linked to framework indicators, configurable rating scale and domains with look-fors and descriptors, comparison with the previous observation, strengths and next steps from a comment bank, submission rules for formal observations and walkthroughs, and a teacher reflection and acknowledgement step for staff portals.
features: Lesson timer with time-stamped evidence notes (teacher, student, quote, environment)
Evidence linked to framework indicators, with evidence-required rules
Configurable rating scale, weighted domains, look-fors and level descriptors
Change versus previous observation on every indicator and domain
Strengths and next steps with click-to-insert comment bank, goal and follow-up dates
Formal vs walkthrough requirements, minimum evidence and clickable validation
Summary with weighted overall level, domain bars, distribution, strengths and growth areas
Teacher mode: reflection and acknowledgement; read-only leadership mode
Designed phone layout (375/360/320 px), keyboard and screen-reader support
15 outputs plus a DOM event for Power Pages scripts
